SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
Section 1, Special Branch Division,
REPORT
Date November 30, 1938.

Subject Communication dated 17.11.38 from the Netherlands
Consulate-General concerning Mr. V.I. Soboleff.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev Forwarded by

Valentin Ivanovich SOBOLEFF, Russian, born on
December 27, 1885 in Chernigov Province, Russia. When
registering with the Russian Emigrants' Committee, 118/1
Moulmein Road, on 6.3.33 he stated that he left the U.S.S.R.
for Manchuria in 1929 and subsequently resided in Harbin
where he was employed with the Municipal Administration for
about one year. Early in 1930 he arrived in Shanghai
and resided for various periods in this city and Hankow until
1932 when he left for Nanking, reportedly to work in the
Central Mint. In 1933 he proceeded to Tientsin where he
is reported to have since been connected with Twyford
Engineering Co., 113 Rue de Chaylard.

He returned to Shanghai on November 13, 1938 and has
since been residing at 635 Rue Ratard, House 4.

According to his own statement, he is a graduate of
the Polytechnic Institute, St. Petersburg (1912) and from
1914 to 1918 served in the Russian Army.

While in Shanghai he did not come to the notice of
the Municipal Police in connection with any activities of
an undesirable nature.

D.B.R.
30/11

D.C. (Special Branch)

A. Prokofiew
D. S. I.

档案编号............
特务科第一股，
报告
日期：1938年11月30日。

事由：荷兰总领事馆1938年11月17日来函，涉及V.I.索博列夫先生。

由特别调查员普罗科菲耶夫撰写 转呈

瓦连京·伊万诺维奇·索博列夫（Valentin Ivanovich SOBOLEFF），俄国人，1885年12月27日出生于俄国切尔尼戈夫省。他于1933年3月6日在穆尔明路118/1号的俄国侨民委员会登记时称，其于1929年离开苏联前往满洲，随后居住在哈尔滨，并在该市市政当局任职约一年。1930年初，他抵达上海，此后断续居住于本市及汉口，直至1932年离开前往南京，据称是在中央造币厂工作。1933年，他前往天津，据报道此后一直与霞飞路113号的特威福德工程公司（Twyford Engineering Co.）有关联。

他于1938年11月13日返回上海，此后一直居住在拉塔德路635号4室。

据其本人陈述，他毕业于圣彼得堡理工学院（1912年），并于1914年至1918年间在俄国军队服役。

他在上海期间，未因任何不良性质的活动引起工部局警务处的注意。

D.B.R.
11月30日

副总监（特务科）

A. Prokofiew
特别调查员

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No.3312.                                SHANGHAI,        17th November 1938.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / S. P. REGISTRY / No. S. B. D. _______ / Date _______ 1938. / 37）

Sir,

    I have the honour to inform you that Mr.Valentin Ivanovich
Soboleff has applied to this Consulate General for a visé for
admission into the Netherlands Indies.

    Soboleff is in possession of a Chinese passport No.2056,
issued by the Bureau of Public Safety in Tientsin on the 18th
November 1937, valid for one year.

    According to this passport he is born at Tchernikoff, 49 years
of age and a mechanical engineer by profession.

    His wife and daughter, who have a separate passport are re-
siding at Tientsin, where they will remain for the time being.

    On November 22, 1937 Soboleff obtained a visé for admission
into the Netherlands Indies from the Acting Consul of the Nether-
lands at Tientsin.

    However circumstances did not allow him at that time to leave
for Java.

    He has not given up however his intention to establish himself
in the Netherlands Indies where he wants to start a business for
his own account.

    He resides at 635 Rue Ratard.

    I should be greatly obliged to you if you would let me know
whether anything is known about this person from a political or
moral point of view.

                                            I have the honour to be,

    D.S.J. Radcliffe                          Sir,
          E.W.
                                            Your obedient servant,

The Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch,                               （签名）
Shanghai Municipal Police,                Acting Consul-General.
    SHANGHAI.

                                        （签名）      81/4 R.
                                    P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.)

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电话地址：HOLLANDIA。

第3312号。                                上海，        1938年11月17日。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 / 特别股登记处 / 编号 S. B. D. _______ / 日期 _______ 1938年 / 37）

先生：

    谨此通知阁下，瓦连京·伊万诺维奇·索博列夫（Valentin Ivanovich Soboleff）先生已向本总领事馆申请前往荷属东印度入境的签证。

    索博列夫持有中国护照第2056号，该护照由天津公安局于1937年11月18日签发，有效期一年。

    根据该护照记载，他出生于切尔尼科夫（Tchernikoff），现年49岁，职业为机械工程师。

    其妻女持有另一本护照，目前居住在天津，并将暂时留居该地。

    1937年11月22日，索博列夫从荷兰驻天津代理领事处获得了前往荷属东印度入境的签证。

    然而，当时因情况所限，他未能启程前往爪哇。

    但他并未放弃在荷属东印度定居的打算，他希望在那里自营商业。

    他现居于拉塔德路（Rue Ratard）635号。

    如蒙告知从政治或道德角度是否掌握有关此人的任何情况，本人将不胜感激。

                                            谨致

    D.S.J. 拉德克利夫                          先生，
          E.W.
                                            您顺从的仆人，

副总监，
特别股，                               （签名）
上海公共租界工部局警务处，                代理总领事。
    上海。

                                        （签名）      81/4 R.
                                    P. A. to D. C. (Sp. Br.)
